traits.name: Quick Capture
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature hits or touches the flytrap. Effect The flytrap makes a leaf Strike against the triggering creature. If it hits, the creature is grabbed in that leaf.

traits.name: Focused Assault
traits.text: ⬺ The flytrap attacks a single target all four of its leaves. The flytrap makes one leaf Strike. On a success, the flytrap deals the damage from one leaf Strike plus an additional 1d8 (1d8) damage for every leaf beyond the first. On a failure, the flytrap deals the damage from one leaf Strike, but it can't use Improved Grab. It deals no damage on a critical failure. This counts toward the flytrap's multiple attack penalty as a number of attacks equal to the number of leaves the flytrap has.

traits.name: Hungry Flurry
traits.text: ⬺ The flytrap makes four leaf Strikes at a –2 penalty, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the flytrap's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all its attacks.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ leaf +23 (reach 15 feet); Damage 2d8+7 (2d8+7) piercing plus 2d6 (2d6) acid and Improved Grab
